verdicts.reason: A: the oversized three-line headline dominates the left side while the body copy, a tiny CTA and legal text as big as the body are squeezed into a narrow, choppy right column. The legal text reads at nearly body size, the can floats on the left with dead space beside it, and the banner overlaps the bubble at top right, so the layout reads as two unrelated halves. B: the reading order from logo to can to headline to CTA is sound and the CTA is prominent, but the headline leaves 'last' orphaned on its own line. The legal text is jammed between the body and the CTA instead of sitting at the bottom, the banner and logo are pushed into the top corners leaving the top crowded, and the CTA overlaps the decorative circle.
